
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
mp_.2 <- read.csv("~/IICD/IICD/Bar Plot/minipatch_results.csv")
mp_.5 <- read.csv("~/IICD/IICD/Bar Plot/5_minipatch_results.csv")
```

```{r}
mp_.2[2,1] <- "0.2 MP decision tree"
mp_.2[4,1] <- "0.2 MP boosting"
mp_.2[6,1] <- "0.2 MP mlp"

mp_.5[2,1] <- "0.5 MP decision tree"
mp_.5[4,1] <- "0.5 MP boosting"
mp_.5[6,1] <- "0.5 MP mlp"
```

```{r}
mp_.5[2,]
```


```{r}
indices <- c(2,4,6)
all_minipatch_results <- mp_.2

n=2

for (i in indices){
  all_minipatch_results <- rbind(
    all_minipatch_results[1:n, ],
    mp_.5[i,],
    all_minipatch_results[-(1:n), ]
    )
  n = n+ 3
}
```
